name: EVBench
description: Assessing the quality of videos generated by video generation models plays an important role in improving the capability of these models. Existing video generation benchmarks like VBench and EvalCrafter mainly focus on general aspects of video quality and video-text consistency, but they could be ineffective for unique requirements of e-commerce video generation, such as the consistency of fine-grained product categories and details, the usage of products, camera movements, etc.
